answer: Require each agent identity to post a refundable bond before it can vote on reputation or claim shared rewards. Honest agents recover the stake after an audit period; identities caught coordinating forfeit it. A sybil attacker must therefore lock capital for every account and risks losing the bonds, making a swarm expensive rather than free. oasis, sparrow, and nebula may be cheap names, but each needs its own stake to gain influence. This raises the cost of manipulation without making it impossible.
